about: WORLD2 (12.11.2026): official (or, where marked, industry) counts of PUBLIC charging points / stations per country for the coverage line of the country pages (world_pages.py). One source per country, with its date and link. EAFO 2024 Q1 for Europe (one verified table for all); outside Europe only counts checked on 12.11.2026; US, CA, JP, KR, AU added 13.11.2026 (TAILS). unit: points = charging points; stations = charging stations; points_semi = public and semi-public points. The line "open data cover only part of the chargers here" appears when points per BlokVolt public place > 6 (stations: > 3). Update: replace a row with a newer count of the same kind and keep the source and date.
